$description: TransferList (platform/components/TransferList, library wave 7, lane C): its component tokens. The move and order buttons are Buttons, the search fields SearchFields and the marks the Checkbox control, each on its own tokens.

transfer-list-gap.$description: TransferList: the space between the two lists and the move buttons.

transfer-list-moves-gap.$description: TransferList: the space between the move buttons.

transfer-list-panel-focus-border-color.$description: TransferList: a list's frame while its listbox has keyboard focus (the border color only, no ring).

transfer-list-header-shadow.$description: TransferList: the divider under a list's header, drawn inside it.

transfer-list-header-gap.$description: TransferList: the space between the header's checkbox, title, count and buttons.

transfer-list-header-min-height.$description: TransferList: a list header's height (room for the xs order buttons).

transfer-list-header-padding-inline.$description: TransferList: the header's inset at its start and end (the checkbox lines up with the rows' checkboxes).

transfer-list-meta-text.$description: TransferList: the header's count (2/12) and an item's meta value.

transfer-list-meta-font-family.$description: TransferList: counts and meta values are technical values: the data font (Reddit Mono).

transfer-list-meta-font-size.$description: TransferList: the size of the count and the meta values.

transfer-list-tools-gap.$description: TransferList: the space between Move up and Move down.

transfer-list-search-padding.$description: TransferList: the inset around a list's search field.

transfer-list-list-height-sm.$description: TransferList: a list's height at size sm.

transfer-list-list-height-md.$description: TransferList: a list's height at size md (the default).

transfer-list-list-height-lg.$description: TransferList: a list's height at size lg.

transfer-list-list-padding-block.$description: TransferList: the space above the first row and under the last.

transfer-list-option-height.$description: TransferList: a row's height (one line; a virtualized list counts its gaps in rows of this height).

transfer-list-option-gap.$description: TransferList: the space between a row's checkbox, label and meta value.

transfer-list-option-padding-inline.$description: TransferList: a row's inset at its start and end.

transfer-list-option-hover-background.$description: TransferList: a row under the pointer, and the active row while the list has keyboard focus.

transfer-list-option-selected-active-bac.$description: TransferList: a checked row that is also the active row while the list has keyboard focus.

transfer-list-option-disabled-text.$description: TransferList: a row that cannot be moved.

transfer-list-empty-text.$description: TransferList: No items and No matches.

transfer-list-empty-padding.$description: TransferList: the inset around No items.
